intro:
A stepper for a multi-step flow: where the reader is, what is behind them, and what is left.

**It does not own your flow** — it reflects whichever step your app says is active. For a flow the component runs itself, question by question, use [Questionnaire](/docs/components/questionnaire).
usage:
<Steps value={step} onValueChange={setStep}>
  {items.map((item, index) => (
    <Steps.Item key={item.title} step={index} className="flex-1">
      <Steps.Trigger>
        <Steps.Indicator />
        <Steps.Title>{item.title}</Steps.Title>
      </Steps.Trigger>
    </Steps.Item>
  ))}
</Steps>

parts.Item: One step. `step` is its zero-based position.
parts.Trigger: Makes the item selectable. Omit it for a read-only stepper.
parts.Indicator: The circle — step number, a check once complete, a spinner while loading.
parts.Title: Step heading.
parts.Separator: Connector to the next step. Every item draws one already — write it only to dress a particular connector, inside the item whose state it reads.

notes:
Steps are zero-based internally but the indicator renders them as 1, 2, 3.

The connectors are drawn for you: the root counts the items it holds and every one but the last joins to the next, so there is no separator to forget or leave dangling. Pass `separators={false}` for a stepper with none, or put a `Steps.Separator` inside an item to dress that one connector yourself — an item that has its own keeps it and gets no second.

Knowing the count is also what lets a step say where it sits: a screen reader reaching the middle of a wizard hears the step's title, then its position and state — “Payment, step 2 of 3, completed”.

examples.title: A horizontal wizard
examples.description: `value` is the index of the current step; anything before it is completed. The connector between one item and the next comes with the item.
examples.code:
const [step, setStep] = useState(1);

<Steps value={step} onValueChange={setStep}>
  <Steps.Item step={0} className="flex-1">
    <Steps.Trigger>
      <Steps.Indicator />
      <Steps.Title>Account</Steps.Title>
    </Steps.Trigger>
  </Steps.Item>
  <Steps.Item step={1} className="flex-1">
    <Steps.Trigger>
      <Steps.Indicator />
      <Steps.Title>Payment</Steps.Title>
    </Steps.Trigger>
  </Steps.Item>
  <Steps.Item step={2}>
    <Steps.Trigger>
      <Steps.Indicator />
      <Steps.Title>Confirm</Steps.Title>
    </Steps.Trigger>
  </Steps.Item>
</Steps>

examples.title: Vertical, with descriptions
examples.code:
<Steps orientation="vertical" value={step}>
  <Steps.Item step={0}>
    <Steps.Trigger>
      <Steps.Indicator />
      <View className="flex-1">
        <Steps.Title>Connect your repo</Steps.Title>
        <Steps.Description>We only read metadata.</Steps.Description>
      </View>
    </Steps.Trigger>
  </Steps.Item>
  {/* …more items… */}
</Steps>
